exposure: Presence or absence of pre-existing NCDs
cohort: 817 pregnant women at Aga Khan University Hospital, Pakistan
finding: Pre-existing non-communicable diseases (NCDs) increase the risk of negative pregnancy outcomes, including preterm birth, elective caesarean section, and low birthweight.
mod_finding: Type 2 diabetes significantly increased the risk of elective CS, while elective CS was significantly increased by hypertension and asthma.
birth_weight: Type 1 diabetes significantly increased birthweight from 2832 to 3253g
